summary: Iter7 regression for COOKIE_SAMESITE env-var change in set_auth_cookies. Ran full in-scope backend suite (backend_test.py 23 + test_iter4_guest_flow.py 8 = 31 baseline) + new test_iter7_samesite_cookie.py (4 new tests): 35/35 passed. Iter7 tests verify: (a) live POST /api/auth/login on preview URL sets 'access_token' cookie with 'SameSite=none; Secure; HttpOnly' when backend .env has COOKIE_SAMESITE=none, (b) /api/auth/me still resolves 200 same-origin with those cookies, (c) unit-level fallback: with COOKIE_SAMESITE unset, set_auth_cookies emits SameSite=lax and honors COOKIE_SECURE=false (backward compatible), (d) unit-level with COOKIE_SAMESITE=none forces Secure=true even when COOKIE_SECURE=false. Frontend smoke on preview URL: /, /products, /cart, /guest-checkout, /register all HTTP 200. Signup + login e2e with a fresh email succeeded end-to-end (auth/me = 200 in both flows). Only console errors observed are the same benign guest-side /api/auth/me 401 polling flagged in iter5/iter6.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py set_auth_cookies now correctly forces Secure=true when SameSite=none (browsers reject SameSite=None without Secure). Good.

Note: test_iter3_reviews_razorpay_cors.py::test_login_sets_secure_httponly_cookie still asserts SameSite=lax and WILL fail with the new .env — as flagged by E1, this is expected. Consider deleting that stale assertion in the same PR since it will now permanently red for cross-origin deploys.
backend/.env has COOKIE_SAMESITE=none unquoted while other bool-ish vars are quoted (e.g. COOKIE_SECURE="true"). Not a bug (python-dotenv reads both), but inconsistent — worth normalizing.

render.yaml sets COOKIE_SAMESITE=none for the backend service — correct for the cross-subdomain iwi-frontend.onrender.com / iwi-backend.onrender.com pair. Verify Render also propagates COOKIE_SECURE=true (it already does).

rca of the issue: N/A — config-driven change verified. set_auth_cookies (server.py L69-80) reads COOKIE_SAMESITE (default 'lax'); when 'none' also forces secure=True. .env has COOKIE_SAMESITE=none which is loaded via load_dotenv on server import. Verified via both live HTTP inspection and direct helper unit tests. Fix for the original prod bug (Chrome blocking cross-site SameSite=lax cookies between iwi-frontend.onrender.com and iwi-backend.onrender.com so /api/auth/me returned 401) is sound; render.yaml propagates COOKIE_SAMESITE=none so /api/auth/me will now receive the cookies cross-origin. The product-creation bug (wrong path /api/admin/products vs /api/products) is not a code fix — POST /api/products with admin auth is the correct endpoint (backend_test.py::TestProducts::test_size_variants_persist covers this path, still passing).
